name: Mithridates I of Pontus
role: Persian nobleman and founder of the Kingdom of Pontus

checks.lead: Mithridates I Ctistes (Greek: Mιθριδάτης Kτίστης; reigned 281–266 BC), also known as Mithridates III of Cius, was a Persian nobleman and the founder (this is the meaning of the word Ctistes, literally Builder) of the Kingdom of Pontus in Anatolia.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
